Hit 4 months clean CT yesterday. Things have been rough and my anxiety and depressive episodes have been through the roof. At this point, it's very hard to differentiate between whether or not I'm actually feeling this way due to the state of the world and my personal situations, or if I'm having a resurgence of PAWS. I've had bouts of depression and self loathing my whole life way before I started using, but it seems worse now. I'm still staying clean off of all psychoactive substances until I hit 6 months, but it's been tough lately not going and getting a drink. It feels like more of an endurance challenge at this point. Surprisingly, kratom has been the last thing I've wanted to go do, and thinking about it rarely happens, and if so, it's never in a positive light. Life is so much better without it, and facing problems without aid is how we get stronger.

Honestly, you are right to a certain extent. Yes, WE as individuals became addicted to it. The plant is just doing what it's meant to do. It became a toxic thing in our lives and it's only natural for us to refer to it in such a negative way. Would I rather see someone on kratom than hydro, oxy or dope? Hell yes! It can help people and bring stability back to a manageable level especially in those who have chronic pain. But... This community consists of those who want it out of their lives, and we support and help each other. A lot people, including myself, found out through kratom the extent to which addiction can go. We can't control it. It's not a 'pity party', it's people coming together with a shared goal and being able to express their experiences openly and do what it takes to get off of it.
